question: Which of the following is the largest brackish water lake in Asia?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chilika**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chilika is the largest brackish water lake in Asia**__.

 __
 
• It is Asia’s largest and the world’s second-largest lagoon.
 
• It spreads over the Puri, Khurda, and Ganjam districts of Odisha on the east coast of India, at the mouth of the Daya River.
 
• It flows into the Bay of Bengal.
 
• In 1981, it was designated the first Indian wetland of international importance under the Ramsar Convention.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Loktak Lake **is the largest natural freshwater lake in India. It is famous for the phumdis (heterogeneous mass of vegetation, soil and organic matter at various stages of decomposition) floating over it.
 
• **Pulicat Lagoon** is the second largest brackish water lagoon in India. It is along the Coromandel Coast.
 
• **Wular Lake **is sited in Bandipora district in Jammu and Kashmir. The lake basin was formed as a result of tectonic activity and is fed by the Jhelum River.
